title: What are Student Loans?
content: Currently, I am at that stage in life where I have begun to realize just how important financial literacy is. Throughout my adolescence, money was an issue my parents had to solve since most of the adults in my life had told me not to worry about it. My task was to do well in school so I could get a good job in the future. While that advice wasn’t necessarily false, it didn’t tell me how to handle the income I would soon earn. Fast forward to my undergraduate years, and I still look back with a chuckle, reminiscing on the interesting financial decisions made by a young adult who began working part-time and looking to the internet to learn what it meant to be financially free. As someone who watched their family struggle to make ends meet, I wanted to ensure that I managed my money well so my family didn’t have to work as hard in the future. However, I didn’t know how to do that, and I still struggle with that today as a 23-year-old. I have watched YouTube and TikTok videos, read articles and books, listened to podcasts, and I can assure you that I reached information fatigue quite some time ago. While I am in a different position than I was five years ago, it shouldn’t be this difficult or time-consuming to learn how to manage the one thing we are all required to use every day for the rest of our lives.
